title: SMM J04135+10277: a distant QSO-starburst system caught by ALMA
question: What are the dust continuum, molecular gas content and CO excitation of the quasar and its star-forming companion in SMM J04135+10277, and is the quasar really gas-poor?

data.sensitivity: Continuum RMS 27.8 uJy/beam (B4), 46.7 uJy/beam (B6); line RMS 0.32 and 0.38 mJy/beam at 77 km/s

what.value: CO(1-0) line luminosity and width of companion; QSO 3 sigma upper limit

evidence.quote: (cite: 2016ApJ...827...18S) reported a line luminosity of $L_{\rm CO(1-0)}^{'}=(8.6\pm1.7)\times10^{10}\, \rm K\,km\,s^{-1}\,pc^{2}$

what.value: CO(1-0) and CO(3-2) observations used in SLED

evidence.quote: combined with CO(1-0) and CO(3-2) line observations from the literature

recipe.goal: Image continuum and measure source fluxes
recipe.method: Natural-weighted CLEAN continuum images; fluxes and sizes of QSO and companion measured

recipe.goal: Fit FIR SED and derive L_IR and SFR
recipe.method: MR-MOOSE Bayesian fit of ALMA+SCUBA+ArTeMiS, and alternative Chary & Elbaz templates
key_parameters: 25% QSO contribution assumed in SCUBA bands for templates
assumptions: Dust heated by star formation; Chabrier IMF; lensing corrected

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and fit CO lines
recipe.method: Spectra extracted from cubes and fitted with Gaussians for widths and integrated fluxes
Moment 1/2 maps, PV diagram at -30 deg, GalPak3D rotating disk model
key_parameters: Exponential disk, arctan rotation curve, default settings

recipe.method: Solomon et al. 1997 L'CO equation; M_H2 = alpha_CO L'CO(1-0); QSO assuming thermalised CO(5-4)
assumptions: alpha_CO=0.8; lensing corrected; L'(4-3)/L'(1-0)=1 for QSO

recipe.method: RADEX grid of Tkin and nH2 with fixed N_CO, chi2 comparison to CO SLED J=1-8
key_parameters: QSO: width 300 km/s, N_CO=1e16 cm-2; companion: 850 km/s, 1e17; Tkin 10-400 K, log nH2 2-7
assumptions: Spherical geometry, H2 only collision partner, CMB background at z=2.84

evidence.quote: the molecular gas mass of the quasar is $(2.3\pm0.2)\times10^{10}\,\rm M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$

not_stated_but_needed: Updated flux values used to redo flux calibration
Line-free channels and clean thresholds/masks, cell and image size
Rest frequencies and integration windows for line fluxes
MR-MOOSE priors and setup, and ArTeMiS/SCUBA fluxes used
RADEX grid step sizes and observed SLED inputs with errors
How continuum fluxes and sizes were measured (fitting method)
Which Gaussian fitting procedure was used for spectra
score_reason: Public data and moderate recipe, but several imaging and fitting details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, short observations, numeric fluxes, line widths and gas masses reproducible.
